title: Pure Majestic Mech
summary: The three classic 2006 Majestic Mech LIGHT Fairy monsters paired with Soul of Purity and Light, Double Summon, and a Rank 6 and Rank 8 Xyz toolbox to cash the Mechs in before their End Phase self-destruction drawback.

summary.title: Starters & Core Monsters
points: Majestic Mech - Ohka is a Level 6 2400 ATK LIGHT Fairy that can be Normal Summoned without Tributing, sending itself to the GY during the End Phase.
Majestic Mech - Goryu is a Level 8 2900 ATK piercing LIGHT Fairy that can be Tribute Summoned with 1 Tribute, sending itself to the GY during the End Phase.
Majestic Mech - Senku is a Level 4 LIGHT Fairy that draws a card when it inflicts direct battle damage before leaving in the End Phase.
Soul of Purity and Light Special Summons itself by banishing two LIGHT monsters from your GY, pairing with Ohka for Rank 6 Xyz plays.

summary.title: Opening: Ohka into Rank 6 & Rank 8
steps: Normal Summon Majestic Mech - Ohka without Tributing, or activate Double Summon to Tribute Ohka for Majestic Mech - Goryu.
With two LIGHT monsters in the GY from spent Mechs or handtraps, Special Summon Soul of Purity and Light alongside Ohka.
Overlay Level 6 Ohka and Level 6 Soul of Purity and Light into a Rank 6 Xyz before the End Phase so Ohka never triggers its self-send drawback.
Optionally rank up any Xyz you control into Rank 8 Dark Ceruvim Irisfil.

summary.title: Bypassing the End Phase Drawback
summary.text: Ohka and Goryu only send themselves to the GY during the End Phase if they remain face-up on the field after being summoned with reduced Tributes. Using them as Xyz, Link, or Tribute material during Main Phase 2 converts their free high-Level bodies into permanent Extra Deck threats while loading LIGHT Fairies into the GY for Soul of Purity and Light.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Number 25: Force Focus is a Rank 6 Xyz that detaches a material as a Quick Effect on either turn to negate the effects of an opponent's Level 5 or higher monster.
Gauntlet Launcher detaches materials to destroy up to two opposing monsters, while Dragonlark Pairen revives a Level 5 or lower monster.
Dark Ceruvim Irisfil overlays directly onto any Xyz Monster you control as a Rank 8 LIGHT Fairy finisher.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Archlord Kristya, Ultimate Offering, and Beatrice, Lady of the Eternal, which are mentioned on the archetype page, are Forbidden in the TCG.
